text: This report lays out directions to guide the work of the Tourism Services Unit in the Economic Development and Culture (EDC) Division until the end of 2028. Historically, the Tourism Services Unit has been focused on operating visitor information services, such as the Toronto Tourism Information Centre (TTIC), Info-to-Go, We've Been Expecting You, and the Festival and Events Calendar. Additional activities include providing one-on-one and online information regarding local attractions and amenities.
